summary: Result of the handler example: in ansible-core 2.15 the handler from the second include_role (with when inventory_hostname == 'bar') wins, so it runs only on bar, whereas 2.14 ran the first handler on all hosts and the second again on bar.
questions: Why is my handler skipped on all hosts except one after upgrading?
Did ansible-core 2.14 run duplicate role handlers twice?

answer_card.title: Handler behaviour: 2.15 vs 2.14
answer_card.answer_md:
- **2.15**: the last `foo_handler` (from the second `include_role`, carrying `when: inventory_hostname == "bar"`) is used. It runs **only on `bar`**, other hosts skip it, and notifications are de-duplicated.
- **2.14 and older**: the first `foo_handler` ran on **all** hosts, and the second ran **again** on `bar`.
